nieuw.titel: Consider Temple Guard for remaining core points
nieuw.tekst: For Legacy Lizardmen, he thinks Temple Guard may be the next best use of core points after Skinks and the ten mandatory Saurus Warriors.
nieuw.waarom: He says he has tried many configurations and found few good alternatives.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He warns that these infantry units become expensive quickly and sees units costing over 200 points as targets for ridden monsters trying to recover their investment.

bronnen.citaat: Temple guard might be the next best way to spend core points

extraCitaten.citaat: I've tried a lot of different configurations and there aren't great options

nieuw.titel: Leave room for casualties in your marching column
nieuw.tekst: Avoid a marching column that loses its formation after a single casualty. He uses five ranks of two rather than a 2-2-1 formation.
nieuw.waarom: He warns that losing the rear model from a 2-2-1 formation ends its marching-column movement benefit and leaves the unit vulnerable.

nieuw.titel: Try advancing slow anvils in marching column
nieuw.tekst: Consider marching slow infantry forward in marching column and accepting the first charge, particularly with Stubborn. He suggests this for an anvil that can survive the hit and fall back in good order.
nieuw.waarom: He uses the triple-speed march to move his infantry 12 inches and sees Fall Back in Good Order as a source of resilience after taking the charge.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says to avoid being doubly outnumbered and losing access to Fall Back in Good Order. His successful demonstration used Temple Guard; he has not yet established that Saurus Warriors can replicate it.
